name: What Goes Around Comes Around
overview: Scripture clearly teaches that the consequences of one's actions inevitably return to them, as seen in Proverbs where sowing iniquity leads to vanity and those who dig pits or roll stones will suffer the same fate they intended for others. This principle is echoed in Hosea, illustrating that sowing the wind results in reaping a whirlwind, emphasizing the certainty and severity of divine justice. Isaiah warns that the wicked will receive the reward of their hands, reinforcing personal responsibility before God. Finally, Christ's teaching in Matthew encapsulates this truth positively by urging believers to treat others as they wish to be treated, summarizing the law and the prophets with a call to proactive righteousness.
